scoring_justification: Absolute N_TBA_shell cannot be recomputed from density_profiles.csv because the density units are arbitrary and the pore length is unknown; the core‑shell structural pattern is verifiable, and the reported shell parameters are compared to paper gold ranges.

outputs.description: Radial density profiles of TBA and TOL centers of mass, used to verify the core-shell microphase separation pattern (structural ordering and relative peak heights).
Shell thickness and number of interfacial TBA molecules at saturation, compared to reference ranges from the paper.

output_contract.notes: Density units are arbitrary but must be internally consistent. The checker evaluates structural trends (TBA preferential adsorption in first layer, TOL core dominance) for x_TBA=0.49 and x_TBA=0.71. For shell_analysis.txt, e_shell and N_TBA_shell are checked against expected tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference for e_shell (4.0 Å) and N_TBA_shell (56 molecules) with tolerances
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: page 8 (theoretical model) 'e_shell = 4 Å' and page 9 (GCMC results) 'the solid interface is saturated for N_TBA,s = 56 molecules'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper‐stated values for the structural model and GCMC saturation count

steps.description: Verify core-shell radial density pattern: at x_TBA=0.49, TBA enriched near wall (r<4 Å) and TOL enriched in core (r>8 Å); at x_TBA=0.71, TBA shell near wall (r>8 Å) with TOL in core; all comparisons use a ratio >2 threshold.
Verify shell thickness e_shell and number of interfacial TBA molecules N_TBA_shell against paper gold values (e_shell=4.0 ± 0.5 Å, N_TBA_shell=56 ± 5).
